verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents API key auth, SDKs, CLI, and an MCP server, but nowhere describes scoped, role-based, or least-privilege API key/credential issuance (e.g., per-agent or per-permission keys) for Retell. This is a fair axis for an API/voice-agent platform, but no docs or probes show scoped credential support, so it is unproven.
